subject: Request: Exec sign-off for rare contract waivers — VPC/on-prem
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: 
Date: Mon, 25 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Exec sign-off for rare contract waivers — VPC/on-prem

Team,

Helios Health is pressing for three non-standard concessions on their VPC/on-prem deal (HL-2334). I spoke with Alice this morning — they're in a time-sensitive procurement window and need these items in the SOW before their board signs off next week. Summary: 

- Data residency exception: permit cross-border log pull for audit purposes (they want a 30‑day rolling copy outside their Gov region for troubleshooting).
- Audit access window: request continuous low-latency access for a named third‑party auditor (they propose 24/7 read-only console access for a 90‑day audit period).
- Deployment constraint carveout: allow on‑prem agent with custom kernel that we haven't certified on our standard support matrix.

Attached: latest SOW (v3), their security Q&A, and my draft waiver language (redwood-terms-waiver-draft.docx). 

Ask: need executive sign-off to allow a one-time deviation from our standard residency and audit controls and to permit a supported-but-uncertified agent for this customer. If we do approve, Marissa recommends a one-time onboarding credit to offset engineering support costs; Rishi — need your read on whether we can limit the audit scope and lock the waiver to explicit dates/IDs. Laura — can you flag any operational risks?

Timing: Helios expects our answer by EOD Wednesday PDT (48 hours). Appreciate quick takes — I can synthesize and send back to them.

Thanks,
Naomi Feldman
Account Executive, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
naomi_feldman@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0134

Attachments: Helios_SOW_v3.pdf (SOW), Helios_Security_QA.xlsx (security responses), redwood-terms-waiver-draft.docx (proposal)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 25 May 2026 10:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Exec sign-off for rare contract waivers — VPC/on-prem

Naomi — thanks for the summary and the drafts. Quick thoughts: 

- Residency exception: high risk if we let logs leave the customer's region indefinitely. If we must grant, limit to a tightly scoped 30‑day window, one copy, and require encryption with customer KMS (customer provides proof).
- Audit access: we can allow named third‑party read-only access, but tie it to specific IP ranges, times (business hours preferred) and a signed NDA with our legal team. 24/7 is not acceptable from an ops standpoint unless we get dedicated on-call coverage — which we should charge for.
- Uncertified agent: I'm wary. We can permit a supported beta-path: deploy to a stage node first, do a two-week runbook verification, then allow production for a limited time. Engineering estimates ~120 engineer-hours to validate.

Commercial: recommend a one-time onboarding credit of $60k to close the commercial gap, and add a 12% professional services uplift on future support hours tied to the special deployment.

I can draft the concessions with explicit guardrails. If leadership signs off on the above framing, we can get Alice a clean SOW by Thursday.

- Marissa
Marissa Cole
Director, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Request: Exec sign-off for rare contract waivers — VPC/on-prem

Naomi / Marissa / Laura,

I appreciate the tight timeline. Legal + Security have the same high-level concerns. We can conditionally approve a narrow waiver with the following firm constraints: 

1) Residency: allow one encrypted copy of logs to be exported outside region for a single 30‑day troubleshooting window. The export must be documented, customer-signed, and the data must be stored only in a Redwood-managed bucket with customer KMS and access logs retained for audit. No ongoing cross-border replication.

2) Audit access: permit named auditor access for a 14‑day intensive audit window (not 90 days) and limited to business hours; any extension requires a signed addendum and exec re-approval. All auditor sessions must go through jump-hosts with session recording and be time-limited.

3) Uncertified agent: allow a staged deployment with a two-week verification period in a staging subnet; production go-live requires a written acceptance of operational risk by the customer and a $75k engineering validation fee.

Commercial concessions: approve a one-time onboarding credit of $50k only if Helios signs the addendum that documents all guardrails above and accepts liability for any changes to the uncertified agent. Any SLA exceptions must be explicitly carved out in the SOW.

If leadership agrees, I will prepare the limited waiver language and an exec memo summarizing operational risk and recommended mitigations for Senior VP sign-off.

Rgds,
Rishi Malhotra
VP, Deal Desk & Legal Liaison
Redwood Inference

Alice / Tom — thanks for your patience while we reviewed the requested deviations. After alignment with Deal Desk and Legal, Redwood can proceed under a limited waiver approach. Key points we can agree to (summary):

• Data residency: one encrypted export permitted for a single 30‑day troubleshooting window. Export must be initiated by Helios, stored in a Redwood-managed bucket with customer KMS, and accompanied by a data export log we retain for 12 months. No ongoing cross-border replication.

• Audit access: named third-party auditor access limited to a 14‑day window during business hours. Any extension requires a signed addendum and exec approval. Auditor access will be via sessioned jump-hosts with session recording enabled.

• Deployment: we will allow your on‑prem agent in a staged beta path — two-week verification in staging, followed by production only after sign-off and payment of a $75k engineering validation fee.

Commercial: Redwood will provide a one-time onboarding credit of $50k against the initial commitment in exchange for the signed addendum governing the above terms. All exceptions will be explicitly carved into the SOW and limited to HL-2334.

Next steps: I’ve attached the proposed waiver language (redwood-terms-waiver-draft.docx) and the updated SOW. Please confirm acceptance by signing the addendum by EOD Friday so we can schedule the staging validation. If you prefer a quicker sync, happy to jump on a call tomorrow.

Best,
